---
name: Phase checkpoint
about: Decide, out loud, whether to continue past a phase boundary
title: "Phase N checkpoint: decide whether to continue"
labels: checkpoint
---

Spec section 7 rates scope as the top risk on this project — eight phases plus a 5v5 MOBA, one
person — and the mitigation ends with an instruction rather than an artefact: **say out loud at
each phase boundary whether to continue.** This issue is that sentence, and closing it is what
forces it to be written down.

Deliberately cheap to answer. Answer it anyway.

## Exit criteria

The phase's exit criteria from spec section 6, one line each, ticked or not. Copy them; do not
paraphrase them.

- [ ]
- [ ]

## Demo

The phase's demo from spec section 6, and whether it was actually run. Link the recording, the
screenshot, or the CI run.

## What ships if we stop here

Every phase is meant to end in something independently valuable. Name what a person would have
if the project stopped today, in one sentence. If the answer is "nothing usable", that is the
finding, and it belongs in the decision below.

## Decision

**Continue / Stop / Re-plan** — pick one word.

## What changes if we continue

What the next phase does differently because of what this one taught. "Nothing" is a legitimate
answer and should be written rather than left blank.

---

Record the decision and its date in `docs/decisions/phase-log.md` in the same change that closes
this issue.
